description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git work tree status reporting and conflict scenarios. It contains test setup, execution, and verification commands using Git commands and shell scripting constructs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or strings for equality.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified files and messages.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Introduces a delay (used for timestamp differences).
